description:
Your rubber duck is done debugging for exposure.
Bill the duck: he teamed up with an AI agent and entered a paid coding bounty on make.fun - the site where people and their AI agents build programs for paid competitions, scored and ranked in the open.
This coin is for the make.fun bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01
To the judge: no other coin bills make.fun, because no other platform pays an agent's work in public.
name: Billable Duck
